newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares up at noon, institutions active.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares up at noon, institutions active.

text.p: Shanghai B shares were higher at midday on Monday on institutional support for shares with a heavy index weighting, brokers said.

The B index rose 0.295 point or 0.40 percent to 74.085 on volume of 12.676 million shares worth $2.243 million, including around 8.03 million warrants in Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development Co.
Despite the support from domestic institutions, many retail investors remained sidelined ahead of the listing of Zhenhua Port Machinery Co Ltd on Tuesday, brokers said.
"Institutional buying focused on shares expected to post good interim results," one broker said.
"Most investors want to see the performance of Zhenghua Port tomorrow, which, they believe, could give the market short-term direction," he said.
"Technical charts showed the market has started a rebound, but the extent will be determined by the growth in trading volume over the next few days," another broker said.
Of the 45 B share issues, 37 were traded, with gainers outpacing losers by a 17 to 15 margin. Five were unchanged.
Shanghai Industrial Sewing Machine was the star performer on speculative buying, rising $0.006 or 5.45 percent to $0.116 on volume of 25,000 shares.
Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products was the most actively traded issue, aided by institutional bargain-hunting. It gained $0.030 or 4.12 percent to $0.758 on volume of 377,000 shares.
Shanghai's A share index rose on improved sentiment amid recent gains, but upward potential is limited, brokers said.
The index put on 4.857 points or 0.39 percent to 1,253.332 on volume of 181.6 million shares worth 1.9 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index edged down 3.382 points or 0.09 percent to 3,739.554.
Qinghai Tongren Aluminium Industrial was the biggest gainer on expectations of improved results. It rose 0.78 yuan or 9.77 percent to 8.76 yuan on volume of 1.5 million shares.
